concepts.title: 白亜の大閲覧堂
concepts.scene: Scene: the welcoming great reading hall of the Grand Archive. Eye-level centered perspective across a broad ivory floor into one tall simple white arch framing a circular BLUE EYE skylight. Two clean shallow banks of white bookcases establish this is a LIBRARY, books grouped as large quiet ivory masses with selected cobalt and crimson spines. One long low white reading table leads toward the blue skylight; a single open chronicle and a small crystal reading lamp on it. Two slim crimson hanging cloths provide clear red accents. Soft sunbeams, quiet wonder, inviting adventure. No people. Monumental but humanly comprehensible architecture; do not add tiers of decorative balconies. Architecture fills the wide frame with calm breathing room.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one standalone polished landscape 16:9 game world key visual for the original fantasy card game LORE. Generate ONE complete image, never a collage or multiple panels.
Input image 1 is the CURRENT LORE LOGO, a brand reference and exact small wordmark insert, not a scene to edit. Preserve its distinctive ivory angular letters and blue eye inside compass ring. Use the eye/ring motif very sparingly in the architecture. Include this same readable LORE wordmark as a modest tasteful bottom-center game title, about 19% canvas width, clean contrast against a quiet slightly blue-gray patch of the environment; no opaque title plaque. No other text.
Art direction: Genshin Impact-like luminous high-end anime fantasy environment illustration, painterly background with clean elegant shape design, soft atmospheric perspective and restrained cel-painted edges. Original LORE world and architecture; no existing franchise characters or symbols. Slightly SIMPLE magical library: strong readable silhouettes, broad calm surfaces, 2-3 main architectural masses, airy negative space, restrained ornament, very few floating pages. No baroque excess, no busy filigree, no clutter, no spectacle overload, no dense particles. A finished rich illustration, not a flat diagram or graybox render.
Palette: WHITE is unequivocally dominant, about 75% pearl white/ivory plaster, white stone, pale paper and milky daylight. Both saturated crimson red AND cobalt blue must be clearly visible as controlled key accents, about 8% each, in ribbons, cloth, selected book spines and restrained magic. Tiny dark slate shadows and minimal pale brass only. Avoid overall brown, gold, green, purple, or dark Gothic color dominance. Whites retain form and detail, not blown out.
World context: the Grand Archive of All Histories (万史大書庫) stores histories as bound chronicles; magical reading can awaken recorded history. Attune (アチューン) is a crystalline mana artifact. Reading lamps, ribbon bookmarks, chronicles and a physical book circulation carriage belong here. Each scene should show only the few props relevant to its subject. No UI, HUD, card frames, buttons, stat numbers, watermark or decorative border.

concepts.title: 赤い栞の回廊
concepts.scene: Scene: an intimate quiet magical library gallery, deliberately smaller and simpler than a cathedral. Asymmetric cinematic side view along three tall white arch windows on the right, looking through to soft blue sky. A single curved ivory bookcase on the left, books predominantly white with red and cobalt blocks. In the lower-middle foreground a simple white reading desk holds one open chronicle, its long CRIMSON bookmark drifting gently in a single graceful S-curve, and a small BLUE Attune crystal. An unobtrusive eye-in-ring brass emblem is embossed on the book cover. The curtain at the far end is cobalt, with a thin red tie. Gentle breeze, soft afternoon light, dust only barely visible. No people. Broad white plaster surfaces and simple structural geometry, cozy discovery, premium restrained painterly atmosphere.

concepts.title: 年代記をひらく対読
concepts.scene: Scene: two ORIGINAL adult record collectors face each other across one round white reading table inside a simple luminous white library. Wide cinematic eye-level three-quarter view, environment takes 75% of image, figures full-body or seated three-quarter at modest scale, not character portraits. One wears a simple ivory cloak with a crimson lining, the other a simple ivory cloak with cobalt lining. Restrained scholar clothing, no ornate armor. A single open bound chronicle at the center produces a tiny ethereal blue architectural memory above its pages, with one red ribbon bookmarking the page; a small crystalline Attune and two quiet reading lamps complete the table. A low semicircle of white bookshelves and one large plain arched window frame the intimate ritual. This is 対読, a magical contest of interpreting history, conveyed through attentive facing poses and the shared book, not fighting, weapons, explosive magic or a visible game interface. White daylight, calm anticipation, readable red/blue rivalry.

concepts.title: 回覧車が渡る書庫
concepts.scene: Scene: a quiet elevated white bridge inside the Grand Archive connects TWO simple white library wings, framed in an elegant oblique wide architectural composition. Along the bridge runs a fine pale-brass guide rail carrying ONE small magical book circulation carriage (回覧車): unmistakably a low library trolley with two shelves of bound white, cobalt and crimson books, clean curved handles, and small wheels. It floats just a finger above the rail under subtle blue crystal power. A long crimson bookmark ribbon trails calmly from its single topmost book. Bookcases behind a few white arches establish a library, pale blue airy void and daylight visible between the wings. A small compass-eye seal on the bridge parapet recalls the supplied brand. No people, no trains or industrial gears, no impossible tangled stairs, no dozens of floating structures. Airy exploration and quiet everyday magic. The bridge makes one strong diagonal, white built surfaces dominate.

concepts.title: 第零書庫の白い封印
concepts.scene: Scene: the enigmatic Zero Archive (第零書庫) reimagined as a BRIGHT WHITE sealed library sanctuary, not a dark dungeon. Straight-on slightly low cinematic view into a small circular ivory chamber. One large simple circular door inset in a white wall carries a restrained eye-and-compass geometry derived from the supplied LORE logo, with a narrow cobalt glow around its rim. In front stands one white pedestal with a closed ancient ivory chronicle sealed by a clearly visible CRIMSON ribbon and small red wax seal. A single faceted blue Attune crystal hovers a short distance above it. Only two recessed white bookcase niches with very old mostly ivory books flank the circular door. Diffuse white light falling from a concealed high opening, soft blue shadows, silent mystery and promise of lost history. Minimal forms, one book focal point, no giant magic circles on floor, no swirling debris, no purple, no gold ornament overload, no people.
